description_en: Retrieves a list of collections. Collections include data albums displayed on the Data Map page and categories created in data albums. You can filter collections by type
description_zh: 查询集合信息。 集合的概念包括数据地图页面上的专辑、专辑中的子类目等。 通过本接口可以指定集合类型查询集合信息
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-meta-collections --parent-qualified-name Album.1234 --next-token 12345 --page-size 10 --keyword Keyword --order-by Sort_field --collection-type ALBUM --creator 1200759642363000 --administrator 1200759642363000 --follower 1200759642363000 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListMetaCollections

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the parent collection
parameters.name: parent_qualified_name

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
parameters.help_zh: 分页信息，指定本次读取的起始点
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the sorting field
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
- ALBUM: data album

- ALBUM\_CATEGORY: category in a data album
parameters.help_zh:
查询的集合类型，取值范围：
- **ALBUM**：专辑集合
- **ALBUM_CATEGORY**：专辑内的类目
parameters.name: collection_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collection creator
parameters.name: creator

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collection administrator
parameters.name: administrator

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collection follower
parameters.name: follower
